metadata.title: Secure‑Resilience Crisis & Coordination SSPP
metadata.remarks: System Security and Privacy Plan governing human coordination, communication, and escalation during resilience and crisis events, aligned with NIST SP 800‑184.

import-profile.remarks: This SSPP inherits Secure‑Resilience Platform rules and applies them to crisis coordination activities.

system-characteristics.system-description: Crisis and coordination environments encompass executive leadership, incident command, legal, safety authorities, clinical leadership, communications teams, and external coordination bodies. This SSPP ensures that coordination supports Secure‑Resilience decisions without overriding eligibility or safety constraints.

props.name: domain
props.remarks: Applies to crisis response and coordination functions.

props.name: authoritative-guidance
props.remarks: NIST guidance for cyber incident coordination.

props.name: coordination-boundary
props.remarks: Coordination, escalation, or executive involvement does not grant recovery or resume authority.

props.name: decision-hierarchy
props.remarks: Safety overlays and resilience eligibility cannot be overridden by crisis pressure.

props.name: automation-influence
props.remarks: Crisis coordination must not instruct automation to bypass Secure‑Resilience eligibility.

system-implementation.remarks: Crisis coordination is implemented through structured communication, escalation, and documentation aligned with Secure‑Resilience decisions. This SSPP does not authorize or execute technical recovery actions.

components.title: Secure‑Resilience Core
components.remarks: Defines permitted resilience outcomes that coordination must respect.

components.title: NIST SP 800‑184
components.remarks: Provides coordination, communication, and escalation guidance.

roles.title: Crisis Coordination Lead
roles.remarks: Coordinates response activities and information flow without overriding resilience eligibility.

roles.title: Executive Crisis Sponsor
roles.remarks: Provides executive oversight and decision support; does not authorize technical resume.

roles.title: Legal and Regulatory Coordination
roles.remarks: Ensures regulatory notifications and legal obligations are met.

roles.title: Safety / Clinical Authority
roles.remarks: Provides safety or clinical input; may authorize resume within applicable SSPPs.

roles.title: Crisis Communications
roles.remarks: Manages internal and external messaging aligned with factual system state.

control-implementation.remarks: This SSPP supports NIST SP 800‑184 coordination objectives and operates in conjunction with NIST SP 800‑53 CP and IR controls. It introduces no additional control requirements and does not replace technical enforcement.
